scope: Public SEC EDGAR 424(b)(2) candidate pricing supplements discovered by official full-text search. Candidates require download, hashing, parsing, deduplication and human validation.
quality_gate: No record is training data, realized outcome evidence, or OOS evidence until validated.

committee_review.baseline: 200 SEC candidate URLs catalogued in v1; 10-document pilot downloaded
committee_review.target: 500 unique official candidates, followed by full download, hash, parse and 10% human validation
committee_review.observed_metric: 500/500 unique URLs; 20/20 sampled URLs returned HTTP 200
data_code_config_lineage: queries: Autocallable Phoenix, Phoenix Securities, worst performing, Autocallable contingent coupon
CIK, accession, filename and file date retained per candidate
blockers: No full downloads or content hashes yet.
Evidence class and extraction accuracy require human validation.
acceptance_tests: All candidates have a retrieval outcome recorded.
Every valid document has a SHA-256 and source timestamp.
A 10% human sample confirms at least 95% evidence-class accuracy.
Issuer, filing date and Phoenix-specific terms are parsed for valid documents.
committee_review.next_experiment: Download and parse a 50-document manually reviewed reference subset before scaling to all 500.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Catalog created; URL uniqueness, 20/20 sampled HTTP retrieval and a 50-document download/hash pilot validated; full ingestion remains research-only.
safety_flags: Do not use catalog for training or market outcomes.
Respect SEC rate limits and terms.
Flag ambiguous Phoenix terminology for manual review.
